5: import { validateLibrary, referencedBy, diffEntry, validateSettingsPatch, validateCollectionBody, withFieldDefaults } from '../adminLogic.js';
6: import { wrap } from '../asyncHandler.js';
7: 
8: /** One record in a library collection. `Library` gives each collection its own element type, and
9:  *  this file's CRUD is generic over all fourteen of them by design ΓÇö `getCollection()` has already
10:  *  established the key is real, so the widening happens once, here, rather than at every route. */
11: type LibRow = Record<string, unknown> & { Id: string; Name?: string };
12: 
13: function rowsOf(lib: Library, key: string): LibRow[] {
14:   return (lib as unknown as Record<string, LibRow[]>)[key];
15: }
16: 
17: export const libraryRouter = Router();
18: 
19: libraryRouter.use(requireAuth);
20: 
21: libraryRouter.get('/', wrap(async (_req, res) => {
22:   res.json({ library: await getLibrary() });
23: }));
24: 
25: libraryRouter.get('/validation', requireAdmin, wrap(async (_req, res) => {
26:   res.json({ issues: validateLibrary(await getLibrary()) });
27: }));
28: 
29: libraryRouter.get('/changelog', requireAdmin, wrap(async (_req, res) => {
30:   const log = await listChangeLog();
31:   res.json({
32:     entries: log.map((e) => ({ ...e, Diffs: diffEntry(e.Before, e.After) })),
33:   });
34: }));
35: 
36: /* Restoring a deleted record. Every delete already stored the full record as the changelog
37:    entry's `Before` ΓÇö it just had no way back out, so "there is no undo" was true only because
38:    nothing read it. Restores under the record's *original* Id, which is the whole reason this is a
39:    route rather than the client re-POSTing the payload: a fresh Id would leave every ref that
40:    pointed at the deleted record still dangling. */
41: libraryRouter.post('/changelog/:entryId/restore', requireAdmin, wrap(async (req, res) => {
42:   const entry = await getChangeLogEntry(req.params.entryId);
43:   if (!entry) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'No such changelog entry.' }); return; }
44:   if (entry.Action !== 'delete') { res.status(400).json({ error: 'Only a deleted record can be restored.' }); return; }
45: 
46:   const col = getCollection(entry.Collection);
47:   if (!col) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Unknown collection.' }); return; }
48: 
49:   const before = entry.Before as LibRow | null;
50:   if (!before || typeof before !== 'object' || !before.Id) {
51:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'That entry has no restorable record.' });
52:     return;
53:   }
54: 
55:   const { library: lib, version } = await getLibraryWithVersion();
56:   const arr = rowsOf(lib, col.key);
57:   // Re-creating an Id that is live again would give the collection two records with one Id, and
58:   // every ref to it would resolve arbitrarily.
59:   if (arr.some((x) => x.Id === before.Id)) {
60:     res.status(409).json({ error: `A ${col.singular.toLowerCase()} with that Id already exists.` });
61:     return;
62:   }
63: 
64:   arr.push(before);
65:   await saveLibrary(lib, version);
66:   await appendChangeLog({
67:     Who: req.user!.name,
68:     Action: 'create',
69:     Collection: col.key,
70:     ObjectId: before.Id,
71:     ObjectName: before.Name || before.Id,
72:     Before: null,
73:     After: before,
74:   });
75:   res.json({ object: before });
76: }));
77: 
78: libraryRouter.get('/:collection/:id/referenced-by', requireAdmin, wrap(async (req, res) => {
79:   res.json({ rows: referencedBy(await getLibrary(), req.params.collection, req.params.id) });
80: }));

83:   const settingsError = validateSettingsPatch(req.body ?? {});
84:   if (settingsError) { res.status(400).json({ error: settingsError }); return; }

86:   const before = { ...lib.settings };

88:   await saveLibrary(lib, version);
89:   await appendChangeLog({ Who: req.user!.name, Action: 'update', Collection: 'settings', ObjectId: 'settings', ObjectName: 'Game settings', Before: before, After: lib.settings });
90:   res.json({ settings: lib.settings });
91: }));

93: libraryRouter.post('/export', requireAdmin, wrap(async (_req, res) => {

105:   res.json({ library: incoming });

112:   res.json({ library: fresh });
113: }));

115: libraryRouter.post('/:collection', requireAdmin, wrap(async (req, res) => {
116:   const col = getCollection(req.params.collection);
117:   if (!col) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Unknown collection.' }); return; }
118:   const body = withFieldDefaults(col.fields, req.body ?? {});
119:   const bodyError = validateCollectionBody(col.fields, body, { partial: false });
120:   if (bodyError) { res.status(400).json({ error: bodyError }); return; }
121:   const { library: lib, version } = await getLibraryWithVersion();
122:   const arr = rowsOf(lib, col.key);

124:   // since the spread ran the other way round.
125:   const obj: LibRow = { ...body, Id: newId(col.idPrefix) };
126:   arr.push(obj);
127:   await saveLibrary(lib, version);
128:   await appendChangeLog({ Who: req.user!.name, Action: 'create', Collection: col.key, ObjectId: obj.Id, ObjectName: obj.Name || obj.Id, Before: null, After: obj });
129:   res.json({ object: obj });
130: }));

133:   const col = getCollection(req.params.collection);
134:   if (!col) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Unknown collection.' }); return; }
135:   const bodyError = validateCollectionBody(col.fields, req.body ?? {}, { partial: true });
136:   if (bodyError) { res.status(400).json({ error: bodyError }); return; }
137:   const { library: lib, version } = await getLibraryWithVersion();
138:   const arr = rowsOf(lib, col.key);
139:   const idx = arr.findIndex((x) => x.Id === req.params.id);
140:   if (idx < 0) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found.' }); return; }
141:   const before = { ...arr[idx] };
142:   arr[idx] = { ...arr[idx], ...req.body };
143:   await saveLibrary(lib, version);
144:   await appendChangeLog({ Who: req.user!.name, Action: 'update', Collection: col.key, ObjectId: arr[idx].Id, ObjectName: arr[idx].Name || arr[idx].Id, Before: before, After: arr[idx] });
145:   res.json({ object: arr[idx] });
146: }));

149:    `referencedBy()` has powered a "deleting this will break these" warning in Content Admin since
150:    the panel was built, but nothing enforced it ΓÇö the server deleted regardless, so the warning was
151:    advice a client could simply not render. Blocking outright would be wrong in the other
152:    direction: breaking a ref is sometimes exactly what you mean to do, and the Validation panel
153:    surfaces the dangling ones afterward. So the default refuses and names what would break, and the
154:    client re-sends with `force` only after the admin confirmed through the "Delete and break N"
155:    dialog. A caller that never saw that dialog gets the refusal. */
156: libraryRouter.delete('/:collection/:id', requireAdmin, wrap(async (req, res) => {
157:   const col = getCollection(req.params.collection);
158:   if (!col) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Unknown collection.' }); return; }
159:   const { library: lib, version } = await getLibraryWithVersion();
160:   const arr = rowsOf(lib, col.key);
161:   const idx = arr.findIndex((x) => x.Id === req.params.id);
162:   if (idx < 0) { res.json({ ok: true }); return; }
163: 
164:   const refs = referencedBy(lib, col.key, req.params.id);
165:   if (refs.length > 0 && req.query.force !== 'true') {
166:     res.status(409).json({
167:       error: `${refs.length} other record${refs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} still reference${refs.length === 1 ? 's' : ''} this ${col.singular.toLowerCase()}. Delete it anyway to leave those references dangling.`,
168:       references: refs,
169:     });
170:     return;
171:   }
172:   const before = arr[idx];
173:   arr.splice(idx, 1);
174:   await saveLibrary(lib, version);
175:   await appendChangeLog({ Who: req.user!.name, Action: 'delete', Collection: col.key, ObjectId: before.Id, ObjectName: before.Name || before.Id, Before: before, After: null });
176:   res.json({ ok: true });
177: }));
